creatingBooking.heading: Creating a booking
tips: Click "New Booking" in the top-right corner.
Identify the client with a name plus a phone or email. For an unknown client, enable the Walk-in toggle and leave the fields empty — placeholder names like "anon" or "walk in" are rejected.
Select the service, therapist, date & time and duration — the price auto-fills from the catalog, and a warning appears if you enter a non-standard price.
For couples or groups, use the Companions section: each companion gets their own booking, linked together in a booking group.
You can register a payment (cash, card or voucher) directly in the form. Click Save — the booking appears right away.

clientMatching.heading: Client matching
tips: While typing, matching clients appear in a dropdown — picking one fills all the fields.
If the phone or email you typed belongs to a client with a different name, a dialog asks whether to keep the stored data or update it.
Placeholder names ("anon", "walk in"…) are rejected — for an unknown client leave the fields empty instead.
The Walk-in toggle appears only when creating a booking. When editing one, an unknown client is simply left with the fields empty.

bookingDialog.heading: Editing a booking
tips: Update any field and click Save Changes. Payments and tips are managed from the same dialog.
You can change the client, service, therapist, date/time, price, and status.
To cancel a booking, change the Status field to "Cancelled" and save.
The Group section shows the other bookings of a group, and lets you add the booking to another booking's group.

payments.heading: Payments
tips: Open a booking and click "Add Payment" to record a new payment.
You can split payments between cash, card, and voucher.
Never include a tip in the payment amount. Enter only the service price here, and record the tip with "Add" in the Tips section.

tips.heading: Tips
tips: Open a booking, scroll to the Tips section, and click "Add".
Select the therapist, amount, and method (cash or card).
IVA applies automatically to card tips; cash tips carry no IVA. A tip's date is its booking's appointment date.
A tip is not a payment: charge the client the service price plus the tip, but enter only the service price in the payment dialog. When a tip is recorded, that dialog shows the total to charge.

phoneEmail.heading: Phone & email format
tips: Phone numbers default to Spanish format (e.g. 666123456). For international numbers, type the country code with a + prefix (e.g. +33 609415297 for France).
Emails must follow the standard format (e.g. name@example.com).

statuses.heading: Booking statuses
tips: Pending (transitional): the client is interested but hasn't confirmed yet. Use it to hold their details and desired time so you don't lose them.
Confirmed (transitional): the client has confirmed they are coming. Use this once the appointment is set and you are expecting them.
Completed (final): the session is done and the client has left. Switch to this once the appointment has finished.
Cancelled (final): the client didn't show up or cancelled. No payments or therapist assignment are allowed on a cancelled booking. Always leave a note explaining the reason.

blocks.heading: Calendar blocks
tips: Click any event block on the calendar to open it.
Each block shows paid/price and is colour-coded by payment status; it refreshes automatically after payments and refunds.

navigating.heading: Navigating the calendar
tips: Use the ← → arrows to move to the previous or next day/week/month.
Click "Today" to jump back to the current date.
Switch between "By therapist", "Day", "Week", and "Month" views using the buttons top-right.
"By therapist" shows therapists as side-by-side columns, plus an Unassigned column for bookings without a therapist.

dailyTotals.heading: Daily totals & closing the day
tips: "Daily totals" opens the money summary for the visible day: bookings, vouchers and tips, plus the end-of-day grand totals (tips included).
"Close day" marks all of the day's confirmed bookings as Completed in one step.
It only applies to today or past days — if there is nothing to close, a message explains why.

table.heading: The bookings table
tips: Type a client name or phone number in the search bar to filter instantly.
Click any column header to sort ascending or descending.
Use the pagination arrows at the bottom to browse older bookings.
Click the pencil icon on any row to open the edit dialog.
The Paid column shows the total amount already collected.

section0.heading: Viewing a client
tips: Click a client row to see their full profile and booking history.
The booking count shows how many times they have visited.

section1.heading: Adding a client
tips: Click "New Client" in the top-right corner.
Name is required. Add a phone or email so the client can be found and matched in bookings later.

section2.heading: Finding a client
tips: Use the search bar to filter by name, phone, or email.

section0.heading: Reading the table
tips: Each row is a payment event — one booking can have several rows if paid in parts.
The Method column shows how the client paid: cash, card, or voucher.
Refunds appear as negative amounts.

section1.heading: Recording a payment
tips: Payments are recorded inside the booking — open the booking from Calendar or Bookings and click Add Payment.
You cannot add a payment directly from this page.

section0.heading: What services control
tips: Services define what treatments you offer and their standard durations and prices.
When creating a booking, selecting a service + duration will auto-fill the price.
If a booking's price doesn't match the catalog for that service and duration, the booking form shows a soft warning with the standard price.

section1.heading: Adding a service
tips: Click "New Service" and enter a name and short name.
Add one or more duration/price combinations (e.g. 60 min → €65, 90 min → €80).

section2.heading: Editing a service
tips: Click the pencil icon on a service row to update its name or prices.
Changes apply to new bookings only — existing bookings keep their original price.

section0.heading: Managing therapists
tips: Click "New Therapist" to add a team member.
Give at least a name or a nickname — the app displays the nickname when present. Phone, email, and notes are optional.
Therapists appear in the booking form and in the By-therapist calendar view.

section1.heading: Archiving a therapist
tips: Archive a therapist when they stop working: they disappear from new-booking dropdowns but keep all their history, and can be restored anytime.
Past bookings are not affected, and Stats keeps showing archived therapists for the periods they worked.

section0.heading: Creating a voucher
tips: Click "New Voucher": enter the buyer (and an optional recipient — defaults to the buyer), the initial balance, payment method and expiry date.
Choose the source: Physical or Online — online vouchers can carry an external reference.
A unique code (e.g. V-150626-1) is generated automatically.

section1.heading: Applying a voucher to a booking
tips: Open the booking, click Add Payment, and open the Voucher section.
Search the voucher by code, client name, phone, email, notes or reference — hover an option to see its full details.
Picking it auto-fills the amount up to the remaining balance; the balance is deducted when you save.

section2.heading: Balance & expiry
tips: Search by the voucher code or client name to find it in the table — the Balance column shows the remaining credit.
Expired vouchers that still hold balance are highlighted so you can flag them to the client.
Open a voucher to add balance, refund a payment, or review its uses — each use links to its booking.

section3.heading: What each field means
tips: Created at: the date and time the voucher was purchased in real life — i.e. when it was paid. Backdate it if you're entering it later; the time defaults to when you opened the form, so set it too whenever you know the real one.
Balance: the initial balance the voucher was created with.
Expiration Date: set automatically to 180 days after the Created at date (you can still override it).
Source: Physical if issued at the counter desk, Online if purchased on the public website.
External Reference: the online voucher's ID from the purchase-confirmation email — leave blank for physical vouchers.

section0.heading: Changing the date range
tips: The From/To pickers are always visible, and both dates are inclusive.
Use the preset buttons (Today, This week, This month, etc.) to switch quickly — editing a date switches to a manual range.
Charts bucket by Day/Week/Month — Day is the default for ranges up to ~45 days; switch with the buttons on each chart.

section1.heading: Reading the dashboard
tips: The six cards at the top are the key business numbers for the selected period.
Total revenue follows the Include chips (Bookings / Vouchers / Tips) in the Revenue section — Tips is off by default because tips aren't real revenue.
The refunds chip next to the Revenue title shows the refunds for the selected streams.
Tips charts can be filtered by method (cash/card) and by therapist; per-therapist cards include archived therapists for the periods they worked.
Scroll down for bookings by service and hour, client retention, voucher sales vs redemptions, and therapist hours.

section2.heading: Who sees what
tips: Only admins see the full dashboard; receptionist and therapist accounts see the Therapist Hours section.

section0.heading: What this page shows
tips: Every tip in the period, one row each — filter by therapist and date range (same pickers as Stats).
Dates are the booking's appointment date, and the Booking column (client · service · time) opens the booking.
Admins can switch between All / Pending / Released; other roles see pending tips only, and therapist accounts are view-only.

section1.heading: Releasing a payout
tips: Select pending tips with the checkboxes — a summary bar shows the gross, IVA and net totals.
Only admins can release: "Release selected" marks the tips as paid out.
The net amount (after IVA) is what the therapist receives. Released tips leave the pending view.

section2.heading: Recording a tip
tips: Tips are added inside a booking — open the booking and scroll to the Tips section.
Choose the amount and method: card tips get IVA automatically; cash tips don't.

section0.heading: Getting started
tips: Use the sidebar to navigate between pages.
Click "New Booking" from the Calendar or Bookings page to create a booking.
Each page has its own help — navigate there and re-open this panel.
